SELECT
  p.entry,
  p.entry_name,
  p.protein_names,
  g.gene_name,
  f.function_id,
  l.location_id,
  d.disease_id,
  b.use_id AS biotechnological_use_id,
  ph.pharma_id AS pharmaceutical_use_id,
  td.dose_id AS toxic_dose_id,
  ap.property_id AS allergenic_property_id,
  i.interaction_id,
  t.lineage_id AS taxonomic_lineage_id,
  a.site_id AS active_site_id,
  bs.binding_id,
  m.mutagenesis_id,
  td2.domain_id AS topological_domain_id,
  pa.pathway_id,
  pfam.family_id
FROM proteins p
LEFT JOIN protein_genes pg ON pg.protein_id = p.protein_id
LEFT JOIN genes g ON g.gene_id = pg.gene_id
LEFT JOIN functions f ON f.protein_id = p.protein_id
LEFT JOIN subcellular_locations l ON l.protein_id = p.protein_id
LEFT JOIN disease_involvement d ON d.protein_id = p.protein_id
LEFT JOIN biotechnological_uses b ON b.protein_id = p.protein_id
LEFT JOIN pharmaceutical_uses ph ON ph.protein_id = p.protein_id
LEFT JOIN toxic_doses td ON td.protein_id = p.protein_id
LEFT JOIN allergenic_properties ap ON ap.protein_id = p.protein_id
LEFT JOIN interactions i ON i.protein_id = p.protein_id
LEFT JOIN taxonomic_lineage t ON t.protein_id = p.protein_id
LEFT JOIN active_sites a ON a.protein_id = p.protein_id
LEFT JOIN binding_sites bs ON bs.protein_id = p.protein_id
LEFT JOIN mutagenesis m ON m.protein_id = p.protein_id
LEFT JOIN topological_domains td2 ON td2.protein_id = p.protein_id
LEFT JOIN protein_pathways pa ON pa.protein_id = p.protein_id
LEFT JOIN protein_family_memberships pfm ON pfm.protein_id = p.protein_id
LEFT JOIN protein_families pfam ON pfam.family_id = pfm.family_id
WHERE p.entry = 'P01308';

SELECT COUNT(*) AS protein_count
FROM proteins;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_protein_entries
FROM proteins;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT gene_name) AS distinct_gene_names_count
FROM genes;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS protein_family_count
FROM protein_families;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS allergenic_property_record_count
FROM allergenic_properties;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p.protein_id) AS distinct_protein_count
FROM proteins p
JOIN binding_sites bs ON bs.protein_id = p.protein_id
WHERE bs.ligand ILIKE '%FAD%';

SELECT f.description AS function_description
FROM proteins p
JOIN functions f ON f.protein_id = p.protein_id
WHERE p.entry = 'P01308'
ORDER BY f.function_id;

SELECT
  p.entry,
  p.entry_name,
  p.organism,
  p.protein_names,
  length(p.sequence) AS sequence_length,
  f.description AS function_description,
  sl.location AS subcellular_location,
  di.disease_name,
  di.description AS disease_description,
  biu.description AS biotechnological_use,
  phu.description AS pharmaceutical_use,
  td.dose_description,
  td.measurement_unit,
  ap.description AS allergenic_property,
  i.interacting_protein,
  i.interaction_type,
  tl.rank_order,
  tl.lineage_path,
  asite.description AS active_site_description,
  asite.position AS active_site_position,
  bs.start_position,
  bs.end_position,
  bs.ligand,
  bs.description AS binding_site_description,
  m.position_start,
  m.position_end,
  m.original_residue,
  m.mutated_residue,
  m.description AS mutagenesis_description,
  m.effect AS mutagenesis_effect,
  tdmd.domain_name,
  tdmd.start_position AS domain_start_position,
  tdmd.end_position AS domain_end_position,
  tdmd.description AS domain_description,
  g.gene_name,
  pw.pathway_name,
  pf.family_name
FROM proteins p
LEFT JOIN functions f ON f.protein_id = p.protein_id
LEFT JOIN subcellular_locations sl ON sl.protein_id = p.protein_id
LEFT JOIN disease_involvement di ON di.protein_id = p.protein_id
LEFT JOIN biotechnological_uses biu ON biu.protein_id = p.protein_id
LEFT JOIN pharmaceutical_uses phu ON phu.protein_id = p.protein_id
LEFT JOIN toxic_doses td ON td.protein_id = p.protein_id
LEFT JOIN allergenic_properties ap ON ap.protein_id = p.protein_id
LEFT JOIN interactions i ON i.protein_id = p.protein_id
LEFT JOIN taxonomic_lineage tl ON tl.protein_id = p.protein_id
LEFT JOIN active_sites asite ON asite.protein_id = p.protein_id
LEFT JOIN binding_sites bs ON bs.protein_id = p.protein_id
LEFT JOIN mutagenesis m ON m.protein_id = p.protein_id
LEFT JOIN topological_domains tdmd ON tdmd.protein_id = p.protein_id
LEFT JOIN protein_genes pg ON pg.protein_id = p.protein_id
LEFT JOIN genes g ON g.gene_id = pg.gene_id
LEFT JOIN protein_pathways pp ON pp.protein_id = p.protein_id
LEFT JOIN pathways pw ON pw.pathway_id = pp.pathway_id
LEFT JOIN protein_family_memberships pfm ON pfm.protein_id = p.protein_id
LEFT JOIN protein_families pf ON pf.family_id = pfm.family_id
WHERE p.entry = 'P01308'
LIMIT 1000;

SELECT DISTINCT
    d.disease_name,
    d.description,
    d.omim_id
FROM proteins p
JOIN disease_involvement d
    ON d.protein_id = p.protein_id
WHERE p.entry = 'P35499'
ORDER BY d.disease_name NULLS LAST, d.omim_id NULLS LAST, d.description NULLS LAST;

SELECT DISTINCT sl.location
FROM proteins p
JOIN subcellular_locations sl ON sl.protein_id = p.protein_id
WHERE p.entry = 'P04637'
ORDER BY sl.location;

SELECT DISTINCT
    b.ligand
FROM proteins p
JOIN binding_sites b
    ON b.protein_id = p.protein_id
WHERE p.entry = 'P00533'
  AND b.ligand IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY b.ligand;

SELECT DISTINCT g.gene_name
FROM proteins p
JOIN protein_genes pg ON pg.protein_id = p.protein_id
JOIN genes g ON g.gene_id = pg.gene_id
WHERE p.entry = 'P04637'
ORDER BY g.gene_name;

SELECT pfm.family_name
FROM proteins p
JOIN protein_family_memberships pfm ON pfm.protein_id = p.protein_id
WHERE p.entry = 'P04637';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT i.interacting_protein) AS interaction_partners
FROM proteins p
JOIN interactions i ON i.protein_id = p.protein_id
WHERE p.entry = 'P04637';

SELECT COUNT(*) AS interaction_count
FROM interactions i
JOIN proteins p ON p.protein_id = i.protein_id
WHERE p.entry = 'P04637';

SELECT
  m.position_start AS position,
  COALESCE(m.description, m.effect) AS description
FROM proteins p
JOIN mutagenesis m
  ON m.protein_id = p.protein_id
WHERE p.entry = 'P04637'
ORDER BY
  m.position_start,
  m.position_end NULLS LAST,
  m.mutagenesis_id;

SELECT
  domain_name,
  start_position,
  end_position
FROM topological_domains
JOIN proteins ON proteins.protein_id = topological_domains.protein_id
WHERE proteins.entry = 'P00533'
ORDER BY start_position;

SELECT
  p.entry,
  a.description AS active_site_description,
  a.position
FROM proteins p
JOIN active_sites a
  ON a.protein_id = p.protein_id
WHERE p.entry = 'P00533'
ORDER BY a.position;

SELECT
  p.entry AS accession,
  p.entry_name AS entry_name
FROM proteins p
JOIN disease_involvement d
  ON d.protein_id = p.protein_id
WHERE d.disease_name ILIKE '%cystic fibrosis%';

SELECT DISTINCT p.pathway_name
FROM proteins AS pr
JOIN protein_pathways AS pp
  ON pp.protein_id = pr.protein_id
JOIN pathways AS p
  ON p.pathway_id = pp.pathway_id
WHERE pr.entry = 'A0AVI4';

SELECT p.entry AS accession, p.entry_name
FROM proteins p
JOIN protein_genes pg ON pg.protein_id = p.protein_id
JOIN genes g ON g.gene_id = pg.gene_id
WHERE g.gene_name = 'BRCA1'
ORDER BY p.entry;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT pfm.protein_id) AS protein_count
FROM protein_family_memberships pfm
JOIN protein_families pf ON pf.family_id = pfm.family_id
WHERE pf.family_name ILIKE '%protein kinase superfamily%';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT pfm.protein_id) AS protein_kinase_superfamily_members
FROM protein_family_memberships pfm
JOIN protein_families pf
  ON pf.family_id = pfm.family_id
WHERE pf.family_name ILIKE 'protein kinase superfamily';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT pfm.protein_id) AS protein_count
FROM protein_family_memberships pfm
JOIN protein_families f
  ON f.family_id = pfm.family_id
WHERE f.family_name ILIKE '%G protein-coupled receptor 1%';

SELECT pf.family_name
FROM proteins p
JOIN protein_family_memberships pfm ON pfm.protein_id = p.protein_id
JOIN protein_families pf ON pf.family_id = pfm.family_id
WHERE p.entry_name = 'EGFR_HUMAN';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p.protein_id) AS protein_count
FROM proteins p
JOIN protein_pathways pp ON pp.protein_id = p.protein_id
JOIN pathways pw ON pw.pathway_id = pp.pathway_id
WHERE pw.pathway_name = 'Protein modification; protein ubiquitination.';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p.protein_id) AS proteins_count
FROM proteins p
JOIN protein_pathways pp ON pp.protein_id = p.protein_id
JOIN pathways pw ON pw.pathway_id = pp.pathway_id
WHERE pw.pathway_name ILIKE '%ubiquitination%'
  AND pw.pathway_name ILIKE '%ubiquitin%';

WITH target AS (
  SELECT protein_id
  FROM proteins
  WHERE entry = 'P01308'
)
SELECT
  COUNT(DISTINCT pgm.protein_id) - 1 AS other_protein_count
FROM protein_family_memberships pfm
JOIN target t
  ON pfm.family_id IN (
    SELECT family_id
    FROM protein_family_memberships
    WHERE protein_id = t.protein_id
  )
JOIN protein_family_memberships pgm
  ON pgm.family_id = pfm.family_id;

SELECT DISTINCT
    g.gene_name,
    p.entry AS protein_accession
FROM genes g
JOIN protein_genes pg ON pg.gene_id = g.gene_id
JOIN proteins p ON p.protein_id = pg.protein_id
WHERE g.gene_name IN ('TP53', 'EGFR')
ORDER BY g.gene_name, p.entry;

SELECT ROUND(AVG(LENGTH(sequence)))::int AS avg_sequence_length
FROM proteins;

SELECT MAX(length(sequence)) AS longest_sequence_length
FROM proteins;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS protein_count
FROM (
    SELECT i.protein_id
    FROM interactions i
    GROUP BY i.protein_id
    HAVING COUNT(*) > 50
) t;

SELECT
  ROUND(AVG(binding_site_count)::numeric, 2) AS avg_binding_sites_per_protein
FROM (
  SELECT
    protein_id,
    COUNT(*) AS binding_site_count
  FROM binding_sites
  GROUP BY protein_id
) t;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS proteins_with_exactly_one_gene_name
FROM (
  SELECT p.protein_id
  FROM proteins p
  JOIN protein_genes pg ON pg.protein_id = p.protein_id
  GROUP BY p.protein_id
  HAVING COUNT(pg.gene_id) = 1
) t;

SELECT
    domain_name,
    COUNT(*) AS domain_record_count
FROM topological_domains
GROUP BY domain_name
ORDER BY domain_record_count DESC, domain_name;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS protein_count
FROM proteins p
JOIN mutagenesis m ON m.protein_id = p.protein_id
GROUP BY p.protein_id
HAVING COUNT(*) > 10;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_interaction_records
FROM interactions;

SELECT
  p.entry AS accession,
  COUNT(i.interaction_id) AS interaction_count
FROM proteins p
JOIN interactions i
  ON i.protein_id = p.protein_id
GROUP BY p.entry
ORDER BY interaction_count DESC, p.entry
LIMIT 5;

SELECT
  p.entry AS accession,
  COUNT(i.interaction_id) AS interaction_count
FROM proteins p
LEFT JOIN interactions i
  ON i.protein_id = p.protein_id
GROUP BY p.entry
ORDER BY interaction_count DESC, p.entry
LIMIT 5;

SELECT
    COALESCE(b.ligand, '(NULL)') AS ligand,
    COUNT(*) AS binding_site_count
FROM binding_sites b
GROUP BY COALESCE(b.ligand, '(NULL)')
ORDER BY binding_site_count DESC, ligand
LIMIT 5;

SELECT
  COALESCE(disease_name, '[unknown]') AS disease_name,
  COUNT(*) AS record_count
FROM disease_involvement
GROUP BY COALESCE(disease_name, '[unknown]')
ORDER BY record_count DESC, disease_name
LIMIT 3;

SELECT
    pfm.family_id,
    fam.family_name,
    COUNT(*) AS member_count
FROM protein_family_memberships pfm
JOIN protein_families fam
    ON fam.family_id = pfm.family_id
GROUP BY
    pfm.family_id,
    fam.family_name
ORDER BY member_count DESC, fam.family_name
LIMIT 5;

SELECT
  p.entry AS accession,
  length(p.sequence) AS sequence_length
FROM proteins p
ORDER BY length(p.sequence) DESC, p.entry
LIMIT 10;

SELECT
  p.entry AS accession,
  COUNT(*) AS binding_site_count
FROM proteins p
JOIN binding_sites bs
  ON bs.protein_id = p.protein_id
GROUP BY p.entry
ORDER BY binding_site_count DESC, p.entry
LIMIT 3;

SELECT
  p.entry AS accession,
  COUNT(m.mutagenesis_id) AS mutagenesis_count
FROM proteins p
JOIN mutagenesis m
  ON m.protein_id = p.protein_id
GROUP BY p.protein_id, p.entry
ORDER BY mutagenesis_count DESC, p.entry
LIMIT 5;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS proteins_without_recorded_function
FROM proteins p
LEFT JOIN functions f ON f.protein_id = p.protein_id
WHERE f.protein_id IS NULL;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS proteins_without_function_annotation
FROM proteins p
LEFT JOIN functions f
  ON f.protein_id = p.protein_id
WHERE f.function_id IS NULL;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS proteins_without_subcellular_location
FROM proteins p
LEFT JOIN subcellular_locations sl
  ON sl.protein_id = p.protein_id
WHERE sl.protein_id IS NULL;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p.protein_id) AS protein_count
FROM proteins p
JOIN disease_involvement d
  ON d.protein_id = p.protein_id
LEFT JOIN functions f
  ON f.protein_id = p.protein_id
WHERE f.protein_id IS NULL;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS proteins_with_no_gene_name
FROM proteins p
LEFT JOIN protein_genes pg ON pg.protein_id = p.protein_id
LEFT JOIN genes g ON g.gene_id = pg.gene_id
WHERE g.gene_name IS NULL;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS proteins_without_family_membership
FROM proteins p
LEFT JOIN protein_family_memberships pfm
  ON pfm.protein_id = p.protein_id
WHERE pfm.family_id IS NULL;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p.protein_id) AS proteins_with_zn2_but_no_ca2
FROM proteins p
JOIN binding_sites bs_zn
  ON bs_zn.protein_id = p.protein_id
WHERE bs_zn.ligand = 'Zn(2+)'
  AND NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM binding_sites bs_ca
    WHERE bs_ca.protein_id = p.protein_id
      AND bs_ca.ligand = 'Ca(2+)'
  );

SELECT p.entry
FROM proteins p
JOIN allergenic_properties ap
  ON ap.protein_id = p.protein_id
LEFT JOIN disease_involvement di
  ON di.protein_id = p.protein_id
WHERE di.protein_id IS NULL;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p.protein_id) AS proteins_with_nucleus_location
FROM proteins p
JOIN subcellular_locations sl ON sl.protein_id = p.protein_id
WHERE sl.location ILIKE '%nucleus%';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p.protein_id) AS protein_count
FROM proteins p
JOIN subcellular_locations l ON l.protein_id = p.protein_id
WHERE l.location ILIKE '%secreted%';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p.protein_id) AS protein_count
FROM proteins p
JOIN disease_involvement di ON di.protein_id = p.protein_id
WHERE di.disease_name ILIKE '%cancer%';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p.protein_id) AS protein_count
FROM proteins p
JOIN protein_pathways pp ON pp.protein_id = p.protein_id
JOIN pathways pw ON pw.pathway_id = pp.pathway_id
WHERE pw.pathway_name ILIKE '%glycolysis%';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p.protein_id) AS protein_count
FROM proteins p
JOIN binding_sites b
  ON b.protein_id = p.protein_id
WHERE 100 BETWEEN COALESCE(b.start_position, 100) AND COALESCE(b.end_position, 100);

SELECT COUNT(*) AS alanine_mutations_beyond_500
FROM mutagenesis
WHERE mutated_residue = 'A'
  AND position_start IS NOT NULL
  AND position_start > 500;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS topological_domains_count
FROM topological_domains
WHERE start_position IS NOT NULL
  AND end_position IS NOT NULL
  AND (end_position - start_position) > 1000;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS active_sites_count
FROM active_sites
WHERE position IS NOT NULL
  AND position ~ '^[0-9]+$'
  AND position::int > 500;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS active_sites_above_500
FROM active_sites
WHERE position IS NOT NULL
  AND position::int > 500;

SELECT
  i.interacting_protein,
  MAX(CASE
        WHEN i.interaction_type ~ 'NbExp=[0-9]+' THEN (substring(i.interaction_type FROM 'NbExp=([0-9]+)'))::int
        ELSE NULL
      END) AS max_experiments
FROM proteins p
JOIN interactions i
  ON i.protein_id = p.protein_id
WHERE p.entry = 'P04637'
GROUP BY i.interacting_protein
ORDER BY max_experiments DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 1;

SELECT MAX(substring(i.interaction_type FROM '[0-9]+')::int) AS highest_supporting_experiments
FROM interactions i
JOIN proteins p ON p.protein_id = i.protein_id
WHERE p.entry = 'P04637';

SELECT
  p.entry,
  tl.rank_order,
  tl.lineage_path
FROM proteins p
JOIN taxonomic_lineage tl
  ON tl.protein_id = p.protein_id
WHERE p.entry = 'P04637'
ORDER BY tl.rank_order ASC;

SELECT
  COUNT(*) AS interaction_records_over_20_experiments
FROM interactions
WHERE NULLIF(substring(interaction_type from '[0-9]+'), '') IS NOT NULL
  AND substring(interaction_type from '[0-9]+')::int > 20;

SELECT
  p.entry,
  p.entry_name,
  td.dose_description,
  td.measurement_unit
FROM proteins p
JOIN toxic_doses td
  ON td.protein_id = p.protein_id
WHERE p.entry = 'P04637'
ORDER BY td.dose_id;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT t.protein_id) AS proteins_with_toxic_dose_count
FROM toxic_doses t;

SELECT DISTINCT p.entry AS accession
FROM proteins p
JOIN biotechnological_uses btu ON btu.protein_id = p.protein_id
ORDER BY p.entry;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p.protein_id) AS disease_associated_proteins_with_atp_binding_site
FROM proteins p
JOIN disease_involvement d ON d.protein_id = p.protein_id
JOIN binding_sites bs ON bs.protein_id = p.protein_id
WHERE bs.ligand = 'ATP';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p.protein_id) AS protein_count_with_disease
FROM proteins p
JOIN protein_family_memberships pfm
  ON pfm.protein_id = p.protein_id
JOIN protein_families f
  ON f.family_id = pfm.family_id
JOIN disease_involvement d
  ON d.protein_id = p.protein_id
WHERE f.family_name = 'protein kinase superfamily';

SELECT
    pf.family_name,
    COUNT(DISTINCT pfdm.protein_id) AS disease_protein_count
FROM protein_families pf
JOIN protein_family_memberships pfdm
    ON pfdm.family_id = pf.family_id
JOIN disease_involvement di
    ON di.protein_id = pfdm.protein_id
GROUP BY pf.family_name
ORDER BY disease_protein_count DESC, pf.family_name
LIMIT 1;

SELECT ROUND(AVG(LENGTH(p.sequence)))::INTEGER AS avg_sequence_length
FROM proteins p
JOIN binding_sites b
  ON b.protein_id = p.protein_id
WHERE b.ligand = 'Zn(2+)';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p.protein_id) AS protein_count
FROM proteins p
JOIN subcellular_locations sl
  ON sl.protein_id = p.protein_id
JOIN disease_involvement di
  ON di.protein_id = p.protein_id
WHERE sl.location ILIKE '%Cell membrane%';

SELECT
  p.entry AS accession,
  COUNT(i.interaction_id) AS interaction_count
FROM proteins p
JOIN protein_family_memberships pfm
  ON pfm.protein_id = p.protein_id
JOIN protein_genes pg
  ON pg.protein_id = p.protein_id
LEFT JOIN interactions i
  ON i.protein_id = p.protein_id
WHERE pfm.family_id = (
  SELECT family_id
  FROM protein_families
  WHERE family_name = 'protein kinase superfamily'
  LIMIT 1
)
GROUP BY p.protein_id, p.entry
ORDER BY interaction_count DESC, p.entry
LIMIT 3;

WITH ligand_counts AS (
    SELECT
        bs.ligand,
        p.protein_id,
        p.entry
    FROM binding_sites bs
    JOIN proteins p
        ON p.protein_id = bs.protein_id
    WHERE bs.ligand IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY bs.ligand, p.protein_id, p.entry
)
SELECT
    lc.ligand,
    COUNT(DISTINCT lc.protein_id) AS distinct_protein_count
FROM ligand_counts lc
GROUP BY lc.ligand
ORDER BY distinct_protein_count DESC, lc.ligand
LIMIT 3;

SELECT DISTINCT sl.location AS tissue
FROM proteins p
JOIN protein_genes pg ON pg.protein_id = p.protein_id
JOIN genes g ON g.gene_id = pg.gene_id
JOIN subcellular_locations sl ON sl.protein_id = p.protein_id
WHERE g.gene_name ILIKE 'BRCA1'
ORDER BY sl.location;

SELECT DISTINCT f.description AS go_term
FROM proteins p
JOIN functions f
  ON f.protein_id = p.protein_id
WHERE p.protein_names ILIKE '%insulin%'
   OR p.entry_name ILIKE '%insulin%'
   OR p.entry ILIKE '%insulin%';

SELECT
  'Unknown' AS chromosome
FROM genes g
WHERE g.gene_name ILIKE 'TP53%';

WITH tp53_families AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT pf.family_id
    FROM proteins p
    JOIN protein_family_memberships pfm ON pfm.protein_id = p.protein_id
    JOIN protein_families pf ON pf.family_id = pfm.family_id
    WHERE p.entry_name ILIKE '%TP53%'
       OR p.protein_names ILIKE '%TP53%'
)
SELECT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM proteins pm
    JOIN protein_family_memberships pmm ON pmm.protein_id = pm.protein_id
    JOIN tp53_families t ON t.family_id = pmm.family_id
    WHERE pm.organism ILIKE '%Mus musculus%'
) AS has_mouse_ortholog_of_tp53;

SELECT
  p.protein_id,
  p.entry,
  p.entry_name,
  p.organism,
  p.protein_names,
  length(p.sequence) AS sequence_length,
  p.created_at,
  p.updated_at
FROM proteins p;

SELECT
  p.protein_id,
  p.entry,
  p.entry_name,
  g.gene_name
FROM proteins p
JOIN protein_genes pg ON pg.protein_id = p.protein_id
JOIN genes g ON g.gene_id = pg.gene_id
ORDER BY p.entry, g.gene_name;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS protein_count
FROM proteins;

SELECT
  p.entry,
  p.entry_name,
  f.function_id,
  f.description AS current_description
FROM proteins p
JOIN functions f ON f.protein_id = p.protein_id
WHERE p.entry = 'P04637';

SELECT COUNT(*) AS protein_count
FROM proteins;
SELECT * FROM proteins;

SELECT
    interaction_id,
    protein_id,
    interacting_protein,
    interaction_type
FROM interactions;
